pages.summary: Reorganized registration refusal, native startup, crash callbacks and converted-package attribution into manual sections. Corrected the entry point to horizon_mod_host::main_with, clarified package handle refusal values and removed the render-hook status aside.

Corrected client tag reads, documented block tag enumeration and the optional block-state range result, and organized contracts by subject. Removed migration tables, internal implementation discussion, issue references and future-work notes while retaining author-facing value and refusal rules.
